data.narrative:
AAVantgarde Bio is a Series B-stage biotech company founded by Alberto Auricchio and Natalia Misciattelli that has raised $141M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private biotech firms and 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) operating in the Biotech & Health sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $268M. Peer-Median anchors to a cohort of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B)—producing a median valuation of $3.5B with a range of $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring is inapplicable due to lack of disclosed revenue. The wide dispersion in peer valuations reflects heterogeneity in stage, maturity, and capital efficiency across the cohort.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $228M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. Stage-Progression suggests a conservative floor, while Peer-Median is anchored by outlier valuations, particularly Colossal Biosciences. Key uncertainties include the company's clinical pipeline maturity, capital efficiency relative to peers, and whether comparable companies truly represent equivalent risk and market position. A tighter range would require visibility into specific therapeutic programs and development timelines.
